Sparkling Pomegranate Ginger Cocktail
By: Active Foodie
Published: Tuesday, December 29, 2009 - 9:18am

Ingredients




1 teaspoon ginger simple syrup  (see below for instructions)
2 tablespoons PAMA pomegranate liquor
Champagne
Candied ginger  (click here for candied ginger recipe)
Rimming Sugar

Preparation

1 Wet rim of flute with a wet paper towel.  Dip into pink rimming sugar. 2 Add ginger syrup and PAMA to champagne flute.  Top with Champagne, and add 1 piece of candied ginger.

About


Where has 2009 gone!  What a year it has been!  I completed my first year as an attorney and now have 3 trials under my belt (all wins!!).  I entered the wonderful world of blogging, and have discovered that not only do I have a passion for food and fitness, but also in photography!  (Maybe 2010 will bring me the new Canon 7D I’ve been wishing for! *fingers crossed!*)  I have met so many wonderful and gracious people in the food blogging community!  I still can’t believe how warm, wonderful and welcoming food bloggers are!  I have to say, 2009, you were very good to me.
On that note, I am already so excited about all the things that 2010 has in store!  I am training for my first marathon – the San Diego Rock and Roll Marathon.  I know it isn’t going to be easy, and I am still not quite sure how it is going to fit into my work schedule, but lord knows I will try my darndest!  I am also very excited about learning much more about photography and getting a lot more practice!
To properly bring in the New Year, I wanted to celebrate with a delicious cocktail – New Years calls for festive cocktails.  I love throwing together my own cocktails, and this one is just something that came to mind as I was thinking what I would like to be drinking on New Years.  I LOVE Pama liquor, but I also wanted to incorporate some ginger into my recipe.  I decided that it would be fun and festive to incorporate some candied ginger into a champagne cocktail.  The result was a sparkling pomegranate and ginger cocktail with candied ginger.  Let me just tell you, this drink is something special, absolutely delicious!  I can attest to that as I had to *clean up* the glasses after taking the photos! ;)   So if you are looking for a fun, festive and tasty cocktail to serve this New Years Eve, give this one a try!
I hope everybody had a wonderful 2009, has a fun and festive New Years Eve, and I wish you an even better 2010!
